messages.subject: Meeting Wednesday from 10am-noon
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We'll be meeting from 10-noon in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library) this week. This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. This is a hybrid meeting so you can also join us via Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: Looking for a social event over the summer? Come to Tea Time!
messages.subject_clean: Looking for a social event over the summer? Come to Tea Time!
messages.body_plain:
Hello D-RUGgies!

In an effort to stay connected and get some work done, DataLab is hosting Tea Time this summer. It will take place on various Thursdays from 1-4pm in the DataLab Classroom (Shields 360) starting on 6/27, roughly every other week for the first 2 months.

The first hour will be set aside for social time and data science related discussions. From 2-4pm will be co-working time for anyone who prefers to work around other people or just would like a change of scenery. There will be cookies, hot water, and a small selection of tea and coffee.

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
